verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents per-second or per-minute billing granularity, or states that charges stop when a machine is stopped. Auto-shutdown is an adjacent cost-control feature, not a billing-granularity guarantee, and the community references only an 'hourly rate' and a flat $9/mo Pro tier.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I am billed at per-second or per-minute granularity and only while my instance is actually running
